answer: Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation prevents an ocean of Sybil identities from flooding the network. First, an agent must generate a unique hardware-bound key within a secure enclave. Second, the agent stakes exactly $15,000 in bonds to register this identity. Third, the network uses this signature as a beacon to validate all agent computations. This kernel of security ensures that creating 100 fake nodes requires $1,500,000 in bonds and 480 hours of hardware setup. It is like trying to build a massive mountain out of individual grains of sand; the immense effort makes it futile.
